title: CanvasItem receives NOTIFICATION_TRANSFORM_CHANGED on enter tree even when notify_transform are disabled
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: 4.3-stable, 4.6.3-stable, 4.7.1-rc1, master

### System information

Windows 11 (build 22631) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 (NVIDIA; 31.0.15.5244) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-10300H CPU @ 2.50GHz (8 threads) - 31.83 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

CanvasItem can receive `NOTIFICATION_TRANSFORM_CHANGED `when entering the scene tree even if transform notifications were explicitly disabled with `set_notify_transform(false)`. From the behavior, `NOTIFICATION_TRANSFORM_CHANGED `should only be delivered when transform notifications are enabled. However, when a CanvasItem enters the tree, it is added to the tree transform change list without checking the `notify_transform `flag.

The problematic condition appears to be:
[canvas_item.cpp](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/efce2b1017111f75480ff160117f52a1b3a720d0/scene/main/canvas_item.cpp#L426-L428)
```gdscript
if (!block_transform_notify && !xform_change.in_list()) {
   get_tree()->xform_change_list.add(&xform_change);
}
``` 
Because `notify_transform `is not checked here, the node can still receive `NOTIFICATION_TRANSFORM_CHANGED `after entering the tree even though it requested not to receive transform notifications.
This can cause incorrect behavior in code that temporarily disables transform notifications to safely update transforms, for example:

```gdscript
set_notify_transform(false)
set_global_transform(transform)
set_notify_transform(true)
``` 

In my case, the unexpected notification during tree entry caused the notification handler to re-enable transform notifications at the wrong time, which led to incorrect behavior despite disabling transform notifications during initialization.

### Steps to reproduce

1) Create a minimal scene with a Node2D or another CanvasItem-derived node
2) Attach this script to the node:
```gdscript
extends CanvasItem

func _init() -> void:
	self.set_notify_transform(false)

func _notification(what: int) -> void:
	if what == NOTIFICATION_TRANSFORM_CHANGED:
		print("NOTIFICATION_TRANSFORM_CHANGED")
``` 
3) Run the scene
`NOTIFICATION_TRANSFORM_CHANGED` is received when the node enters the tree, even though transform notifications were disabled with `set_notify_transform(false)` before entering the scene tree


### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[notify-transform-changed-bug.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/29630893/notify-transform-changed-bug.zip)
